official_sources.title: GEOS spatial predicates
official_sources.finding: GEOS implements OGC Simple Features geometry model and predicates including Intersects, Touches, Within, Contains, Covers and Valid.

official_sources.title: GEOS covers boundary semantics
official_sources.finding: covers is more inclusive than contains and does not distinguish boundary from interior; empty geometries return false.

official_sources.title: GEOS prepared geometry
official_sources.finding: PreparedGeometry optimizes repeated predicates while retaining explicit contains/covers/intersects/touches semantics.

official_sources.title: GEOS containsProperly
official_sources.finding: containsProperly requires the test geometry to be wholly in the interior and returns false for any boundary interaction.

official_sources.title: GEOS prepared covers touch fallback
official_sources.finding: Prepared covers uses short-circuits/indexing, but boundary-touch cases may require full topology.

official_sources.title: GEOS prepared contains touch fallback
official_sources.finding: Prepared contains likewise requires full topological evaluation when the test geometry touches polygon linework.

official_sources.title: GEOS contains versus covers boundary distinction
official_sources.finding: GEOS documents contains and covers as closely related predicates differing in specific boundary cases.

official_sources.title: Shapely covers
official_sources.finding: covers returns true when no point of B is outside A, including points on polygon boundaries.

official_sources.title: Shapely covered_by converse
official_sources.finding: covered_by(A,B) is the converse of covers(B,A), enabling independent predicate-direction reconciliation.

official_sources.title: Shapely contains
official_sources.finding: contains excludes objects lying only on the boundary; a polygon does not contain a boundary point.

official_sources.title: Shapely within
official_sources.finding: within is the inverse of contains and differs from covered_by at boundary-only cases.

official_sources.title: Shapely contains_properly
official_sources.finding: contains_properly rejects any common boundary point and is stricter than contains.

official_sources.title: Shapely intersects
official_sources.finding: intersects is true for any shared portion of space and therefore is too broad by itself for parcel membership.

official_sources.title: Shapely intersects_xy
official_sources.finding: intersects_xy avoids Point construction and can test boundary/interior contact efficiently against many raster-cell centers.

official_sources.title: Shapely touches
official_sources.finding: touches is true only when shared points are on boundaries and interiors do not intersect.

official_sources.title: Shapely topological boundary
official_sources.finding: Polygon boundary is a line geometry; explicit boundary extraction allows independent boundary-touch classification.

official_sources.title: Shapely DE-9IM relate
official_sources.finding: relate returns the DE-9IM matrix, providing auditable topology evidence beyond a single boolean predicate.

official_sources.title: Shapely relate_pattern
official_sources.finding: relate_pattern tests DE-9IM matrices against explicit patterns such as within, enabling contract-level predicate replay.

official_sources.title: Shapely prepare
official_sources.finding: Prepared geometry adds segment indexing for repeated predicates; modification creates an unprepared geometry requiring re-preparation.

official_sources.title: Shapely STRtree bbox candidate stage
official_sources.finding: STRtree first indexes axis-aligned 2D bounding boxes and can then apply an exact predicate; bbox hits alone are only candidates.

official_sources.title: Shapely STRtree ignores Z
official_sources.finding: STRtree bounding boxes are 2D and ignore Z, reinforcing separation of horizontal membership from elevation values.

official_sources.title: Shapely validity
official_sources.finding: is_valid identifies whether geometry is well formed; missing input is not valid.

official_sources.title: Shapely validity reason
official_sources.finding: is_valid_reason records diagnostic reasons such as self-intersection, useful for fail-closed boundary ledgers.

official_sources.title: Shapely make_valid methods
official_sources.finding: make_valid linework and structure methods may produce different or lower-dimensional results, so repair method/output must be pinned.

official_sources.title: Shapely precision grid
official_sources.finding: set_precision can drop duplicate vertices, collapse narrow polygons or remove narrow sections; precision changes can alter membership.

official_sources.title: Shapely overlay precision
official_sources.finding: intersection grid_size can snap inputs/results to a precision grid; terminal parcel membership must not silently introduce such snapping.

official_sources.title: Shapely normalize canonical ordering
official_sources.finding: normalize produces consistent coordinate/ring/part ordering for deterministic structural replay.

official_sources.title: Shapely equals_exact
official_sources.finding: equals_exact checks structural coordinate equivalence while equals is only topological; both identities serve different QA roles.

official_sources.title: GDAL geometry validity warning
official_sources.finding: GDAL warns invalid geometries can produce incorrect spatial algorithm results, including intersection tests.

official_sources.title: GDAL validity scope
official_sources.finding: Per-geometry validity does not detect inter-feature gaps/overlaps or qualitative spikes/slivers; those need separate checks.

official_sources.title: GDAL MakeValid
official_sources.finding: OGRGeometry MakeValid may change structure/ring winding or return different geometry collections depending on mode/version.

official_sources.title: GDAL SetPrecision
official_sources.finding: SetPrecision rounds to a precision grid while attempting to preserve validity; this is a geometry mutation requiring explicit provenance.

official_sources.title: GDAL precision RFC
official_sources.finding: roundCoordinates does not guarantee validity whereas SetPrecision does; precision policy must distinguish metadata rounding from topology-preserving reduction.

official_sources.title: GDAL vector make-valid
official_sources.finding: make-valid supports linework/structure algorithms and optional lower-dimensional components; output semantics must be frozen.

official_sources.title: GDAL ogr2ogr makevalid/xyRes
official_sources.finding: ogr2ogr can apply MakeValid and SetPrecision during translation; derived boundaries must not silently replace immutable source geometry.

official_sources.title: PostGIS ST_Covers
official_sources.finding: ST_Covers includes boundary points and warns against invalid geometries; it also uses bbox indexes only as an optimization before predicate evaluation.

official_sources.title: PostGIS ST_Touches
official_sources.finding: ST_Touches requires common points but disjoint interiors and defines explicit DE-9IM patterns.

official_sources.title: PostGIS ST_Intersects
official_sources.finding: ST_Intersects means any common point; its index-assisted bbox prefilter does not change the exact topological predicate.
